messages:
emily: Quick check-in: building a 2-week sandbox trainer onboarding for new SIs (cloud marketplace + on-prem kit). Need to align training schedule, access tokens, and the joint announcement blackout window. Who can own access provisioning?

omar: I can provision sandbox accounts and short-lived tokens. Will need a CSV of partner emails. Julia, can you consolidate?

julia: Yup, compiling now. Also flagging that some partners asked for GPU type specs in the kit docs (A100 vs H100). We should standardize a recommended config.

emily: Let's recommend H100 for multi-model workloads, A100 as an alternate. Add note that performance numbers are sample-only.

nate: On the training agenda: Day 1 infra labs, Day 2 model serve + perf tuning, Day 3 troubleshoot & go-live checklist. Proposal attached in drive (link in DM).

partner-bot: Reminder: NDAs required for hardware shipments. Partners without signed NDA: "Pioneer Integrations", "BlueSpan SI".

julia: Pioneer Integrations is still pending. Maria, can you follow up?

maria: On it. I'll escalate with legal and include a secure upload link for signatures.

omar: For provisioning: I will create scopes limited to sandbox-only. Tokens expire in 7 days by default. Need approval for 14-day extension for trainers.

emily: Approve 14-day tokens for trainer accounts only. Add a small log of who requested extension.

zack: Trainer materials note: we should swap older CLI examples that use `redwood deploy --region us-west` to new flags `redwood deploy --env=staging`. I'll update slides.

julia: Also include a short troubleshooting card for disk space on kits (common issue). Steps: 1) ssh into node 2) run `df -h` 3) clean /tmp.

emily: Good. Certification: will we issue a micro-badge on successful lab run? What's the pass criteria?

maria: Badge criteria idea: complete 4 labs, pass proctor checklist, and submit short case study (max 500 words). Pass/fail binary.

zack: Proctor checklist draft:
```
- Verify HW boots and agent connects to cloud control plane
- Run sample workload for 3 minutes
- Capture logs and TTF (time to first token)
- Confirm model loads with correct quantization profile
```

omar: For TTF targets set: on-prem kits <350ms, marketplace deployed instances <140ms. We should record medians across 3 runs.

emily: Use those numbers. Also add a note in the playbook: if TTF exceeds target by >30%, file a ticket to eng-ml with sample logs.

julia: Logistics: I created a single tracker sheet and added columns: partner, email, NDA status, kit_shipped, trainer_assigned, cert_status. Link: drive.redwood.com/si-sandbox-tracker (shared).

maria: PR blackout window: propose embargo from ship date until partner signs off post-training (max 14 days). Marketing ok with that?

emily: That works. We'll coordinate a joint announcement checklist: quotes, logos, approval, and final go/no-go. Nate, can you own the marketing sync?

nate: Sure. I'll set a meeting and share a draft timeline.

zack: One more: add an FAQ line about billing in marketplace trials: partners are not charged during the sandbox period; invoice starts after pilot opt-in.

emily: Nice. Action items recap: Omar = sandbox tokens + provisioning; Julia = partner CSV + tracker upkeep; Maria = legal follow-up for NDAs + badge criteria; Nate = marketing timeline; Zack = slide + proctor checklist updates. I'll collate into the handoff doc and ping everyone when ready.

partner-bot: Calendar created: "SI Sandbox Trainer Onboard" Tue 11:00 PT. Invites sent.

emily: Thanks team, closing this thread. Post any late blockers here so we keep a single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
